metadata.description: EDAMAME Security integration for Claude Desktop and related agent surfaces. EDAMAME's host-side observer runs two-plane divergence detection automatically -- no plugin required; this plugin adds off-host coverage, in-agent posture/verdict views, safety-floor guardrails, and turnkey onboarding.
